We will use the following identity:

$$
∇\cdot (f\,F)=f\,∇\cdot F+F\cdot ∇f
$$

First, we compute $∇\cdot F$ and $∇f.$ We get

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f & =⟨\operatorname{cos}⁡x,-\operatorname{sin}⁡y⟩, \\ ∇\cdot F & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(\operatorname{cos}⁡x)+\frac{∂}{∂y}(\operatorname{sin}⁡y) \\  & =-\operatorname{sin}⁡x+\operatorname{cos}⁡y \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡y-\operatorname{sin}⁡x.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}∇\cdot (f\,F) & =f\,∇\cdot F+F\cdot ∇f \\  & =(\operatorname{cos}⁡y+\operatorname{sin}⁡x)(\operatorname{cos}⁡y-\operatorname{sin}⁡x)+⟨\operatorname{cos}⁡x,\operatorname{sin}⁡y⟩\cdot ⟨\operatorname{cos}⁡x,-\operatorname{sin}⁡y⟩ \\  & ={cos}^{2}⁡y-{sin}^{2}⁡x+{cos}^{2}⁡x-{sin}^{2}⁡y \\  & =({cos}^{2}⁡x-{sin}^{2}⁡x)+({cos}^{2}⁡y-{sin}^{2}⁡y) \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡2x+\operatorname{cos}⁡2y.\end{aligned}
$$
